## Hill Number Distance Matrices

```{r}
beta_q0n <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 0)

beta_q1n <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1)

genome_counts <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0))%>%
  rownames_to_column(., "genome")

genome_tree <- keep.tip(genome_tree, tip=genome_counts$genome)

beta_q1p <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1, tree = genome_tree)

genome_counts_filt <- genome_counts[genome_counts$genome %in% rownames(genome_gifts),]
genome_counts_filt <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0))%>%
  rownames_to_column(., "genome")

genome_gifts <- genome_gifts_raw[rownames(genome_gifts_raw) %in% genome_counts_filt$genome,]
genome_gifts <- genome_gifts[, colSums(genome_gifts != 0) > 0]

genome_gifts1 <- genome_gifts[rownames(genome_gifts) %in% genome_counts_filt$genome,]
genome_gifts1 <- genome_gifts1[, colSums(genome_gifts1 != 0) > 0]

dist <- genome_gifts1 %>%
  to.elements(., GIFT_db) %>%
  traits2dist(., method = "gower")

beta_q1f <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1, dist = dist)
```

## Habitat Comparison

### Permanova analysis

```{r}
set.seed(4458)
```

#### Richness

```{r}
sample_metadata_row<- column_to_rownames(sample_metadata, "sample") 
sample_metadata_row <- sample_metadata_row[labels(beta_q0n$S), ]

betadisper(beta_q0n$S, sample_metadata_row$habitat) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE) 
```
```{r}
adonis2(beta_q0n$S ~ habitat, 
        data = sample_metadata %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q0n$S))), 
        permutations = 999)
```

```{r}
g_beta_q0n = 
  
beta_q0n$S %>%
  vegan::metaMDS(., trymax = 500, k = 2, trace=0) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = habitat)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = diet_colors,labels=c("Pre_grass" = "Captive-bred no grass diet", "Post_grass" = "Captive-bred grass diet", "Wild" = "Wild"))+
    #   stat_ellipse(aes(color = beta_q1n_nmds$Groups))+
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_cen, y = y_cen, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2), alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_manual(name = 'habitat', 
                     values = c("rural" = '#5bae63',"urban" = '#986eac'),
                     drop = FALSE) +
    # add significance from permanova
        labs(x = paste("p =",adonis2(beta_q0n$S ~ habitat, 
                                      data = sample_metadata %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q1n$S))), 
                                      permutations = 999)$`Pr(>F)`[1]), y = "")+ 
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position="none"
      #legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +labs(color='Origin')

g_beta_q0n
```

## Site Comparisons

### Permanova analysis & Beta diversity plots

```{r}
set.seed(4458)

# separate by habitat
habitats = levels(as.factor(sample_metadata_row$habitat))

habitat_col = list(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3,"YlGn"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3,"BuPu")
)
```

```{r}
sample_metadata_row<- column_to_rownames(sample_metadata, "sample") 
sample_metadata_row <- sample_metadata_row[labels(beta_q0n$S), ]
```

#### Richness

Test for differences in richness among all sites.

```{r}
betadisper(beta_q0n$S, sample_metadata_row$event_ID) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE) 


adonis2(beta_q0n$S ~ event_ID, 
        data = sample_metadata %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q0n$S))), 
        permutations = 999)
```
##### sperate by habitat

```{r}
beta_q0n_H = list()
bdHp_q0n = list()

for (h in seq_along(habitats)){

# make new beta diversity matrix
beta_q0n_H[[h]] <- genome_counts[,c("genome",
                               colnames(genome_counts)[colnames(genome_counts) %in% 
                                                         rownames(sample_metadata_row[sample_metadata_row$habitat==habitats[h],])
                                                       ])] %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 0)


bdH =  betadisper(beta_q0n_H[[h]]$S, sample_metadata_row[sample_metadata_row$habitat==habitats[h],]$event_ID) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE)
adH =  adonis2(beta_q0n_H[[h]]$S ~ event_ID, 
        data = sample_metadata[sample_metadata$habitat==habitats[h],] %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q0n_H[[h]]$S))), 
        permutations = 999)

bdHp_q0n[[h]] = 
  beta_q0n_H[[h]]$S %>%
  vegan::metaMDS(., trymax = 500, k = 2, trace=0) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(event_ID) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate_at(c('event_ID'), as.factor)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = factor(event_ID, levels = c("MIND","CNSC","PAVI","CTAT","PCAR","SMAT")))) +
    geom_point(show.legend = TRUE, size = 4) +
     scale_color_manual(name = 'Site', 
                     values = c("MIND" = '#add4a0', "CNSC" = '#5bae63', "PAVI" = '#1a7939', 
                                "CTAT" = '#c3a4cf', "PCAR" = '#986eac', "SMAT" = '#742881'),
                     drop = FALSE)+
  
  #   stat_ellipse(aes(color = beta_q1n_nmds$Groups))+
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_cen, y = y_cen, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2), alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = paste("p = ",adH$`Pr(>F)`[1]), y = "") +
    theme(
      #axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      #axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +labs(color='Origin')

print(bdH)
print(adH)
}
print(bdHp_q0n)

```

  remove_rownames() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0))%>%
  rownames_to_column(., "genome")

genome_gifts_H <- genome_gifts[rownames(genome_gifts) %in% genome_counts_FH$genome,]
genome_gifts_H <- genome_gifts1[, colSums(genome_gifts_H != 0) > 0]

dist_H <- genome_gifts_H %>%
  to.elements(., GIFT_db) %>%
  traits2dist(., method = "gower")

# make new beta diversity matrix
beta_q1f_H[[h]] <- genome_counts_FH %>%
 column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1, dist = dist_H)  

bdH =  betadisper(beta_q1f_H[[h]]$S, sample_metadata_row[sample_metadata_row$habitat==habitats[h],]$event_ID) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE)
adH =  adonis2(beta_q1f_H[[h]]$S ~ event_ID, 
        data = sample_metadata[sample_metadata$habitat==habitats[h],] %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q1f_H[[h]]$S))), 
        permutations = 999)

bdHp_q1f[[h]] = 
  beta_q1f_H[[h]]$S %>%
  vegan::metaMDS(., trymax = 500, k = 2, trace=0) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(event_ID) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate_at(c('event_ID'), as.factor)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = factor(event_ID, levels = c("MIND","CNSC","PAVI","CTAT","PCAR","SMAT")))) +
   geom_point(show.legend = TRUE, size = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(name = 'Site', 
                     values = c("MIND" = '#add4a0', "CNSC" = '#5bae63', "PAVI" = '#1a7939', 
                                "CTAT" = '#c3a4cf', "PCAR" = '#986eac', "SMAT" = '#742881'),
                     drop = FALSE)+
    #   stat_ellipse(aes(color = beta_q1n_nmds$Groups))+
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_cen, y = y_cen, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2), alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
        labs(x = paste("p = ",adH$`Pr(>F)`[1]), y = "") +
    theme(
      #axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      #axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +labs(color='Origin')

print(bdH)
print(adH)
}
print(bdHp_q1f)
